purpose: Producer’s signature minimal studio: charcoal or porcelain surfaces, dimensional chrome and customizable perimeter light, with eight paired views and full-canvas cue overlays.
principles: Large source regions, restrained chrome and deliberate type hierarchy.
Current-layout controls use the existing show.layoutId binding; this Set has no Show.
Device identity and account connections remain outside the package.
Motion animates only a graphics-only layer; native source ancestry stays static.
Registered waiting music uses the native DJ mixer; no autoplay or effects imported as music.
Light and dark palettes are authored separately; adjustable edge color retains legible neutral typography.
qualification: Requires canonical/default-state checks, both-theme visual review, every dock size and separate native preparation/recording evidence.
